message.content: {"action":"change_interpolation","reason":"The only evaluated configuration that meets the quality target is the LUT linear-interpolation design at phase_bits=16 (area 1584.56). Precision increases are exhausted, and decreasing precision or switching to CORDIC has not met the quality target while also being larger for CORDIC. Changing interpolation has one legal unvisited neighbor and may improve quality/area tradeoff by altering the LUT interpolation scheme rather than increasing precision further."}
